name: command_gate_unchecked
description: A test command's output feeds an acceptance classify before the exit status is checked; a failed command must not be overruled by an oracle (#431)
input:
use
  llm.classify

task accept_tests
  gives Text
  do
    tests = command ["cargo", "test"] timeout 10m
    verdict = classify "Did the test suite pass? Output: {tests.stdout}" into ["pass", "fail"]
    when verdict.sure -> give verdict
    else -> give "unknown"
